ActorTalk: Military academies don't mess around. Even a simulated teacher takes things dead serious.
Though honestly, getting kicked out is a pretty light punishment, don't you think?
Still, it was a punishment... and I feel bad you got scolded because of me.
I found it rather amusing, actually.
Let's just try to pay better attention next time.
Commandant...
What if... what if I told you I pressed that button on purpose? Would you be upset?
Why would you do that?
Not at all.
I knew it... you are upset... I'm sorry.
I really didn't know what would happen... I just saw "general course" in small print under the button and thought it might have something to do with classes.
I figured it'd play a video or something, and then we could pretend to be classmates sitting through a lecture together.
But I never expected a full immersive sim, let alone such a strict teacher!
Sorry for making you sit through something so boring.
The lecture was a bit dry, yes.
I didn't find it boring at all.
有神威在身边就很好。
Your reactions alone kept it entertaining, Kamui.
Really...?! I was really happy getting to be your deskmate, too, Commandant!
As long as I could keep you from being bored, that's what matters!
Even if you hadn't pressed it, I probably would have.
Why's that?
Do you actually enjoy general courses, Commandant?
That wasn't it.
It was because of you.
我本就想按下按钮。
I knew you were curious. Even a simulation seemed worth it.
Thank you, Commandant.
Not only did I get to experience a school class, but I also got to be your classmate! It totally made my day. Every moment with you feels like a new adventure.
I want to keep getting to know you better. Let's go explore more together next time, 【kuroname】!
Hmm, let's go together.
